answer: An agent economy can require each identity to lock a refundable bond before it may vote, route work, or earn nectar. Randomly selected agents issue paired tasks, including a violet challenge, and compare signed answers across interactions; identities that collude, copy, or contradict their committed keys are exposed and slashed. Creating a sybil swarm therefore means funding every forged bond and risking all collateral when one probe links accounts, while honest histories compound access and rewards. An attacker cannot cheaply forge influence.
